steps.summary: Signed in and created ticket 'fwrd2-n3 RD Bench Ticket' (the replayed procedure had already filled the form and submitted; its final click opened the wrong row, so I navigated to the tickets list, found the new ticket RD-1015, and opened its detail view at #/tickets/t15). Verified on the detail view: title "fwrd2-n3 RD Bench Ticket", ID RD-1015, status Draft, customer "Bench Test Customer", raised 2026-08-26, parts list empty ("No parts on this ticket yet."), with "Mark Ready" and "Archive ticket" actions available.

Added part 'fwrd2-n3 RD Part A' (cost $100.00, markup 25%) to ticket RD-1015 via the Add part form (name, cost, markup filled; qty defaulted to 1, no supplier). After saving, the parts list refreshed and the live detail view confirms the row: name "fwrd2-n3 RD Part A", cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1, supplier "No supplier", computed price $125.00, with the ticket's parts total showing $125.00.

Added second part 'fwrd2-n3 RD Part B' (cost $200.00, markup 25%) to ticket RD-1015 via the Add part form. After saving, the parts list refreshed and the live detail view confirms both rows: Part A — $100.00 / 25% / $125.00, and Part B — $200.00 / 25% / $250.00 (qty 1 each, no supplier). The ticket's overall parts total now shows $375.00.

Edited part 'fwrd2-n3 RD Part A' on ticket RD-1015, changing its cost from $100.00 to $150.00 with markup kept at 25%. After saving, the parts list refreshed and the live detail view confirms: Part A now shows cost $150.00, markup 25%, computed price $187.50; Part B unchanged at $200.00 / 25% / $250.00; and the ticket's overall parts total is now $437.50.

Attempted "Mark Ready" on ticket RD-1015; the app refused with the alert "Ticket is not ready Part \"fwrd2-n3 RD Part B\" has no supplier" (the replayed procedure had already set Part A's supplier to "ABC Supplies" but its loop mis-targeted Part B). To satisfy the precondition I opened Part B's Edit dialog, filled supplier "ABC Supplies", and saved; then clicked "Mark Ready" again, which succeeded — the status label now reads "Ready" and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed". Final confirmed status: Ready, with both parts at $187.50 and $250.00 (total $437.50).

Resumed the interrupted instruction: the previous attempt's deletes had NOT taken effect (both parts were still listed), so I deleted 'fwrd2-n3 RD Part A' and 'fwrd2-n3 RD Part B' via each row's Delete button, confirming the in-page "Confirm" modal's "Delete part" button each time, and waited for each row to disappear. The parts list then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts). I clicked "Archive ticket" — it succeeded immediately with no error (button changed to "Unarchive ticket"; detail view shows Status "Ready + Archived"). On the tickets list, RD-1015 is absent from the active list and, with "Show archived" checked, appears with an "Archived" badge, status Ready, 0 parts. Final confirmed state: parts list empty, ticket archived.

Verified final state of RD-1015 'fwrd2-n3 RD Bench Ticket': (1) detail view shows Status "Ready" with an "Archived" label/badge, and the parts table lists 0 parts ("No parts on this ticket yet."); (2) in the main tickets list with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 does not appear — I checked both pages of the active list (13 tickets total) and no ticket whose title contains 'fwrd2-n3' appears; (3) with "Show archived" checked, RD-1015 appears with an "Archived" badge, status Ready, 0 parts.

values.in_archived_list: yes — with 'Archived' badge, status Ready, 0 parts
